name: px65
description: PX-65: 65C02を搭載した架空のポケコンのエミュレーター

scripts.test: node test/interrupts.test.js && node test/asm.test.js && node test/bus.test.js && node test/watch.test.js && node test/monitor.test.js && node test/basic_fp.test.js && node test/basic_math.test.js && node test/basic.test.js && node test/keyqueue.test.js && node test/samples.test.js && node test/fuzz_gen.test.js && node test/fuzz.js --seed 1 --count 10 --repro-check && node test/dist.test.js
scripts.tables: node tools/mkfont.js && node tools/mkoptable.js && node tools/mkfpconst.js
scripts.monitor: npm run tables && node tools/asm.js rom/monitor.s -o rom/monitor.bin --range A000:FFFF
scripts.testpattern: node tools/asm.js rom/test_pattern.s -o rom/test_pattern.bin --range C000:FFFF -l rom/test_pattern.lst
